_comment: Sanitized snapshot of the openclaw setup for the final RMF skill benchmark (parallel pipeline). API KEYS ARE NOT INCLUDED (they live per-agent in ~/.openclaw/agents/<id>/agent/auth-profiles.json). Host identifiers are generic; benchmark root = $P26_ROOT (default ~/P26exp). An earlier 2026-06-17 snapshot is archived separately, outside this repository.

gpt54.note: tested earlier, excluded from the final parallel run

agent_layout.base_agents: <model>_w / <model>_wo  (workspace ws/<model>_w has skills/rmf-toolkit/; ws/<model>_wo has none)
agent_layout.per_sample_clones: clone_agents.py creates <model>_w0..2 and <model>_wo0..2, each with its own workspace copy, for true parallel runs
agent_layout.binding: openclaw.json agents[].model is the source of truth (runner passes no --model flag)

run_mode.embedded: openclaw agent --local (run_cell_local.py) to avoid single-gateway contention; tokens recovered from the session .jsonl
run_mode.concurrency: 6-way for OpenRouter/Google/DashScope models; 2-way paired (prun2.py) for native deepseek/kimi keys (rate-limit throttling)
